desc: Implement Fenwick-tree inversion counting for the initial sequence \(A\).
Group positions by value and compute each value’s frequency and sum of 1-indexed positions.
Verify and implement the transition formula \(\Delta_x=2\sum_{i:A_i=x} i-\mathrm{freq}[x](N+1)\), with transitions processing \(x=M-1,M-2,\ldots,1\).
Build and print all \(M\) inversion counts using Python integers.
Validate against the three provided samples and relevant edge cases.
